details.eligibility: Master's degree (55% for General; relaxations per UGC notification) in the relevant subject.
details.pattern: Paper I: 50 questions (Teaching/Research Aptitude), 100 marks. Paper II: 100 subject questions, 200 marks. No negative marking. Computer-based test, held twice a year (June & December).
details.syllabus: Teaching Aptitude, Research Aptitude, Comprehension, Communication, Reasoning, ICT, Higher Education System + subject-specific syllabus (83 subjects).

notes: All 3 years in data.js (2024, 2023, 2022) covered. NTA releases UGC NET question papers with the provisional/final answer key on ugcnet.nta.ac.in after each session (portal verified HTTP 200). Shiksha UGC NET papers page returned HTTP 403 on 2026-11-21 and was NOT used. Adda247 2022 papers were not verified on its page (only image-path mentions) so Adda247 is listed only for 2024/2023. YouTube: 5 videos verified via oEmbed; PJKfIeQ3lew returned oEmbed Forbidden but its watch page fetched HTTP 200 and the title/channel come from the search result — treat as verified-by-search, not oEmbed.
